title: Reefer Cargo Services: humidity, oxygen and carbon dioxide settings by tier
content:
## Scope

This comparison of **Reefer Cargo Services** tiers covers the dehumidification (humidity set point) and atmosphere settings (oxygen and carbon dioxide set points) that a reefer service order may carry.

## Rule

1. A humidity set point above 0 is accepted only when the tier offers dehumidification, and then only between the tier's lowest and highest humidity set point.
2. The oxygen set point must lie between the tier's lowest and highest oxygen set point.
3. The carbon dioxide set point may be at most the tier's highest carbon dioxide set point.

The lowest and highest values in the table are themselves accepted values: they are the lowest and highest set points the tier takes.

## Comparison table

| Tier | Dehumidification | Humidity set point range | Oxygen set point range | Highest carbon dioxide set point |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Reefer Standard | Not available | 0 to 0 percent | 21.0 to 21.0 percent | 0.0 percent |
| AHL Reefer Monitored | Available | 60 to 95 percent | 21.0 to 21.0 percent | 0.0 percent |
| AHL Reefer Cold Treatment | Not available | 0 to 0 percent | 21.0 to 21.0 percent | 0.0 percent |
| AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere | Available | 70 to 95 percent | 2.0 to 10.0 percent | 15.0 percent |
| AHL Reefer Pharma GDP | Available | 35 to 75 percent | 21.0 to 21.0 percent | 0.0 percent |
| AHL Reefer Superfreezer | Not available | 0 to 0 percent | 21.0 to 21.0 percent | 0.0 percent |

Humidity is stated in whole percent; oxygen and carbon dioxide in decimal percent.

## What the table means in practice (derived from the rule)

- On the tiers without dehumidification (AHL Reefer Standard, AHL Reefer Cold Treatment and AHL Reefer Superfreezer), no humidity set point above 0 is accepted.
- On every tier except AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere, the oxygen range opens and closes at 21.0 percent, so 21.0 percent is the only accepted oxygen set point, and the highest carbon dioxide set point is 0.0 percent.
- Only AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere accepts a reduced-oxygen, raised-carbon-dioxide atmosphere.

## Hypothetical requests

| Tier | Request | Judgement |
|---|---|---|
| AHL Reefer Monitored | Humidity 60 percent | Accepted: equal to the lowest humidity set point |
| AHL Reefer Monitored | Humidity 55 percent | Not accepted: below the range |
| AHL Reefer Pharma GDP | Humidity 80 percent | Not accepted: above the highest humidity set point of that tier |
| AHL Reefer Cold Treatment | Humidity 85 percent | Not accepted: the tier offers no dehumidification |
| AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere | Oxygen 5.0, carbon dioxide 15.0 percent | Accepted: oxygen inside the range, carbon dioxide at the highest value |
| AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere | Oxygen 1.5 percent | Not accepted: below the lowest oxygen set point |
| AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere | Carbon dioxide 16.0 percent | Not accepted: above the highest carbon dioxide set point |
| AHL Reefer Monitored | Oxygen 8.0 percent | Not accepted: the only accepted oxygen set point on this tier is 21.0 percent |

## Basis Q&A

**A banana shipper wants a controlled atmosphere under AHL Reefer Monitored. Is that possible under these settings?** No. On AHL Reefer Monitored oxygen must be 21.0 percent and carbon dioxide cannot exceed 0.0 percent.

**Humidity set point of 0 on a tier without dehumidification?** The humidity condition restricts only set points above 0.
